description:
From: Optimize. Approved by the user 2026-11-24 ("Enablers first" for fz-mue.7, relayed by Optimize). A page comes before building.

Today: parse_extern_item accepts only `extern "<abi>" defp`, and the extern map hard-codes private: true (src/compiler2/frontdoor.rs:509-515 and :586). So :erts_internal.map_next/3 needs an fz wrapper, which costs fixture 00567 +18 evaluations, +1 executable, zero-change 5->7 and SOURCE_ORDER +4 plans in fz-mue.7.

Fix: an extern may be declared public (`extern "<abi>" def`); map_next is then the runtime call itself, with no wrapper.

Done when: a public extern is callable from another module on run, interp and build (fixture); fz-mue.7's map_next needs no wrapper; no pin rises.
title: An extern can be a public function
